text:
anya: Ok team — finalizing the press/analyst coverage matrix for next week's launch. Need to lock briefing slots, embargo window, and who approves quotes. Can folks ping their owners?

jess: I can own the quote package + fact-check responses. Will post draft in a minute. @anya do we have a hard embargo time? :clock1:

marco: We proposed embargo 10am PT on Tue (regionally friendly for US/EMEA briefings). That gives us morning APAC pickups same day. Is that still the plan?

anya: Yes 10am PT works. Need canary brief with top 3 analysts at 9:15 PT to catch any last-minute ops questions.

press-bot: [automated] embargo set: 2026-04-07T10:00:00-07:00 (10am PT). Reminders scheduled at -24h and -1h.

sarah: For briefing slots: propose 30-min slots. 9:15-9:45 canary (invite only), 10:00-11:30 analyst bloc (3 x 30m), then 13:00-14:30 APAC friendly office hours (3 x 30m). I'll throw invites.

jess: Quote draft below — please review/approve or suggest edits. Short and specific, avoids benchmarks numbers until embargo lifts.

jess (quote draft): "Redwood Inference helps engineering teams deliver predictable, low-latency LLM inference at scale. We're focused on operationalizing performance and cost controls so customers can ship features faster."

aniya (typo note): saved — (note: fix name)

marco: Two quick asks: (1) Legal needs to review any customer callouts — none here, right? (2) Are we routing embargoed benchmark numbers through the analyst ops queue or product?

anya: No customer callouts. Benchmarks will go through product for vetting, then to jess for socialization.

jess: I'll send the quote to legal for a quick sweep (cc @marco). Expect reply by EOD. If legal flags anything, we'll swap to a non-numeric language and note that full numbers are available on request at embargo.

tom: For the coverage matrix, please add primary/backup press contacts and preferred briefing format (1:1, group, demo). I'll build a shared sheet.

anya: Great — tom can you create the sheet and include timezone column? Make the gatekeeper column required.

tom: Done — link: https://docs.example.com/launch/coverage-matrix (internal) — added gatekeepers, formats, and suggested times.

sarah: Also flag any analysts who require an NDA or legal pre-clear. I have a short list; will ping in the doc comments.

jess: Quick edit to quote to avoid noun overload: replace "operationalizing" with "managing" for clarity. New draft posted.

press-bot: [automated reminder] briefing invites sent to: analyst-list@external. Remind list in 24h.

anya: OK — owners: jess for quotes/fact-checks, sarah for scheduling, tom for coverage matrix maintenance, marco for legal sign-off. I'll run the canary brief on Tue 9:15 PT.

marco: Approved. If legal signoff comes late, we fallback to an embargoed "product preview" with no numbers.

jess: Will also prepare a one-page fact sheet and a small FAQ for the briefs. Posting in the doc under "assets".

anya: Perfect. Last ask — who will handle on-the-record vs background distinctions during briefs? We should assign.

tom: I'll be on the call to tag on-record answers; jess can handle quote attribution clarifications.

anya: Excellent. Thanks all — I'll update the matrix and push final invites. :rocket:
